notes:
What's new in 0.27.0

• Playback that recovers: if a source fails you get a plain reason, Try Next Source or Choose Source, and your place is never lost. Failed sources are marked Unavailable.
• Choose Source hides files that are clearly for a different title.
• Zylo's own dialogs for keys, PINs and links (with Show, and Send from Phone), and clear error messages instead of raw codes.
• Discover: a daily spotlight, then every mode grouped with full descriptions.
• Setup ticks off finished steps; Disconnect and Remove ask for a second press.
• Cleaner trailer previews, Zylo-style player controls, and icons instead of emoji.
